description_en: Sets the playback key for an application
kebab_example: aliyun vod set-app-play-key --app-id app-1000231 --play-key yzNgTUtAl6HAuosIA --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetAppPlayKey

parameters.help_en: The application ID. Default value: app-1000000. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。 默认取值：app-1000000。使用说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The playback key.
Only uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and digits are supported. The length must be 8 to 20 characters.
UTF-8 encoding
parameters.help_zh:
播放密钥。
仅支持大小写字母和数字，长度在8 ~ 20个字符之间。
UTF-8 编码
parameters.name: play_key
